Package cp

Class NbConstraintsVariableHeuristic

java.lang.Object
cp.NbConstraintsVariableHeuristic
All Implemented Interfaces:
VariableHeuristic
public class NbConstraintsVariableHeuristic extends Object implements VariableHeuristic
Heuristic for selecting the most or least constrained variable based on the number of constraints in which it is involved.

This heuristic is typically used in constraint satisfaction problems (CSP) to decide which variable to assign a value to next. The variable with the highest or lowest number of constraints can be chosen to optimize the search process.

  • Constructor Details

    • NbConstraintsVariableHeuristic

      public NbConstraintsVariableHeuristic(Set<Constraint> constraints, boolean variableWithMostConstraints)
      Constructs a NbConstraintsVariableHeuristic with the given set of constraints. The heuristic will select the variable with either the most or the least constraints, depending on the specified flag.
      Parameters:
      constraints - The set of constraints that are involved in the CSP.
      variableWithMostConstraints - If true, the variable with the most constraints will be selected. If false, the variable with the least constraints will be selected.

  • Method Details

    • best

      public Variable best(Set<Variable> variables, Map<Variable,Set<Object>> domains)
      Selects the variable that is involved in the most or least constraints, depending on the configuration. This heuristic is commonly used for variable ordering in CSP solvers.

      The method counts the number of constraints each variable appears in, and depending on the configuration, either returns the variable with the most constraints or the least.

      Specified by:
      best in interface VariableHeuristic
      Parameters:
      variables - The set of variables to choose from.
      domains - The domains of each variable (not used in this heuristic, but passed to comply with the interface).
      Returns:
      The most or least constrained variable.
